title: Count The Firewood
text: The camp has 18 logs and gathers 7 more. How many logs are there now?
feedback: 18 plus 7 makes 25 logs.

title: Share The Meals
text: There are 15 meals. The cabin eats 6. How many meals are left?
feedback: 15 minus 6 leaves 9 meals.

title: Fix The Radio Log
text: Choose the sentence with correct capitalization.
feedback: Only the first word and proper names need capital letters here.

title: Add The Period
text: Choose the correctly punctuated warning.
feedback: A command starts with a capital letter and ends with a period.

title: Fuel The Furnace
text: The furnace burns 4 logs each hour. How many logs are needed for 6 hours?
feedback: 4 times 6 equals 24 logs.

title: Patch The Wall
text: A wall patch is 5 feet wide and 3 feet tall. What is its area?
feedback: Area is width times height, so 5 times 3 is 15.

title: Choose To, Too, Or Two
text: Which sentence uses the correct word?

options.label: Bring two buckets to the food prep.
Bring too buckets to the food prep.
Bring to buckets to the food prep.

feedback: Two is the number 2.

title: Ration The Lettuce
text: The cook uses 1/4 of a crate for each meal. How many meals can 3 crates make?
feedback: Each crate has four fourths, so 3 crates make 12 fourths.

title: Measure Fuel
text: A fuel can holds 2.5 liters. The furnace needs 10 liters. How many cans are needed?
feedback: 10 divided by 2.5 equals 4 cans.

title: Their Or There
text: Which sentence is correct?

options.label: The survivors left their packs near the gate.
The survivors left there packs near the gate.
The survivors left they're packs near the gate.

feedback: Their shows ownership.

title: Balance The Soup
text: The recipe uses 2 lettuce bundles for every 1 meat bundle. If the cook has 8 lettuce bundles, how many meat bundles match the recipe?
feedback: A 2 to 1 ratio means 8 lettuce bundles pair with 4 meat bundles.

title: Plan The Lumber Run
text: A lumberjack cuts 3 trees in 15 minutes. At that rate, how many trees can be cut in 45 minutes?
feedback: 45 minutes is three groups of 15 minutes, so 3 times 3 is 9.

title: Fix The Storm Note
text: Choose the sentence with correct punctuation.

options.label: When the blizzard starts, close the shutters.
When the blizzard starts close the shutters.
when the blizzard starts, close the shutters.

feedback: An introductory clause needs a comma, and the sentence starts with a capital letter.

title: Pay The Repair Cost
text: An upgrade costs 40 wood. A failed attempt costs 20% of the price. How much wood is lost?

title: Track Temperature Change
text: The temperature rises from -18 degrees to -7 degrees. How many degrees warmer is it?
feedback: Moving from -18 to -7 is an increase of 11 degrees.

title: Join The Log Entries
text: Which sentence correctly joins two related complete thoughts?

options.label: The gate is cracked; the engineer can repair it.
The gate is cracked, the engineer can repair it.
The gate is cracked the engineer can repair it.

feedback: A semicolon can join two closely related independent clauses.

title: Find The Trail Slope
text: A trail rises 12 feet over a horizontal distance of 4 feet. What is the slope?
feedback: Slope is rise divided by run, so 12 divided by 4 is 3.

title: Solve The Fuel Equation
text: The furnace has 12 logs after burning 3 logs per hour for x hours from a stack of 30. Solve 30 - 3x = 12.
feedback: 30 minus 12 is 18, and 18 divided by 3 is 6.

title: Fix The Report
text: Choose the sentence with clear pronoun agreement.

options.label: Each survivor packed his or her emergency blanket.
Each survivor packed their emergency blanket.
Each survivors packed his emergency blanket.

feedback: Each is singular, so his or her agrees clearly.

title: Solve The Supply System
text: Two fuel cans and one meal weigh 11 pounds. One fuel can and one meal weigh 7 pounds. How much does one fuel can weigh?
feedback: Subtract the second equation from the first: one fuel can weighs 4 pounds.

title: Brace The Arch
text: A roof brace follows h = -x^2 + 6x. At what x-value is the brace highest?
feedback: The vertex is at x = -b/(2a), so x = -6/(2 * -1) = 3.

title: Estimate Storage Volume
text: A supply bin is 4 ft long, 3 ft wide, and 2 ft tall. What is its volume?
feedback: Volume is length times width times height: 4 x 3 x 2 = 24.

title: Improve The Leadership Note
text: Which sentence uses parallel structure?

options.label: The crew needs chopping wood, to cook meals, and guarding the gate.
The crew needs to chop wood, to cook meals, and to guard the gate.
The crew needs wood chopping, to cook meals, and guard duty.

feedback: Each item begins with the same infinitive structure: to chop, to cook, to guard.

title: Set Off Extra Information
text: Choose the sentence with correct commas around nonessential information.

options.label: The engineer who fixed the tower earned extra rations.
The engineer, who fixed the tower, earned extra rations.
The engineer who fixed the tower, earned extra rations.

feedback: The phrase who fixed the tower adds extra information and is set off by commas.

title: Model Heat Loss
text: A room keeps 80% of its heat each hour. If it starts with 100 heat units, about how many remain after 2 hours?
feedback: 100 times 0.8 times 0.8 equals 64.

title: Choose The Clearest Revision
text: Which revision is most concise and clear?

options.label: Due to the fact that the storm is near, we should proceed to close the gate.
Because the storm is near, we should close the gate.
The storm being near is a thing that means gate closure should happen.

feedback: The best revision is direct, concise, and clear.

title: Radio Log Capitalization
text: Which radio log uses capitalization correctly?

options.label: we reached cabin three before dusk.
We reached Cabin Three before dusk.
We Reached cabin three Before dusk.

feedback: The first word and the specific place name should be capitalized.

title: Emergency Punctuation
text: Choose the sentence with correct end punctuation.
feedback: A direct question needs a question mark.

title: Homophone Check
text: Which sentence uses to, too, or two correctly?

options.label: Bring two lanterns to the dining hall.
Bring too lanterns two the dining hall.
Bring to lanterns too the dining hall.

feedback: Two is the number, and to shows direction.

title: Signal Note
text: Which sentence uses since or sense correctly?

options.label: Since the radio failed, the scout used a flare.
Sense the radio failed, the scout used a flare.
The scout had no since of direction.

feedback: Since explains time or cause; sense means awareness or meaning.

title: Supply Depot Note
text: Pick the sentence with the correct there, their, or they are form.

options.label: Their gloves are drying near the furnace.
There gloves are drying near the furnace.
They are gloves are drying near the furnace.

feedback: Their shows ownership.

title: Weather Report
text: Weather report: Winds rise after midnight. Snow is light until 10 p.m. What is the best plan?

options.label: Open the gates during high wind.

feedback: The report says conditions are safer before 10 p.m.

title: Map Clue
text: Map note: The cache is east of the creek and south of the broken tower. Where should the scout search?

options.label: North of the tower and west of the creek.
East of the creek and south of the tower.
Inside the creek near the tower.

feedback: Both map clues must be followed together.

title: Repair Steps
text: Instruction card: First close the vent. Next add fuel. Last restart the generator. What happens second?
